rationale: Follows the verify-issues carve-out precedent at GRAPH_DISCOVERY_GUIDE.md:19-27. Shared rule 2 (Confirm-before-use) is a trust rule and worked correctly on ENH-3000; wire-issue's confirm-before-map rename repurposed it as target-selection, which is the defect. Consumers differ by what a confirmed hit becomes: lead (refine) / verdict input (verify) / executed change target (wire). refine-issue inherits nothing.
rule: wire-issue's reachability/seam rule is a consumer-local stricter rule in graph-discovery-layer.md, not an amendment to GRAPH_DISCOVERY_GUIDE.md's three shared safety rules
